verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a built-in read-only agent 'for exploring codebases' and a plan agent that analyzes code without changes, so it can explore a repo without the user hand-picking files. LSP loading is automatic. However, nothing documents producing a whole-codebase map or explanation, and nothing shows how files are discovered autonomously. missing for 10: documented whole-repo mapping/summary output, explicit description of autonomous context discovery, independent hands-on corroboration of explaining an unfamiliar codebase

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases. Cannot modify files.
This agent is useful when you want the LLM to analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans without making any actual modifications to your codebase.
LSP enabled Automatically loads the right LSPs for the LLM
